The guard against that is `.githooks/pre-commit`, and it had been a silent no-op since the day it was added (f00bd74c, 2026-08-13), for three independent reasons measured in order: (1) `git config core.hooksPath` is `.githooks`, so the hook IS installed, but the committed blob is LF-only (0 CRLF pairs) while the working tree held 62 -- `.gitattributes` has `* text=auto` and no rule for extensionless hook files, and `core.autocrlf=true` therefore materialises CRLF bytes for `sh` to mis-parse; (2) line 20 called bare `python`, which is not resolvable on this machine -- the gate itself has to name the declared interpreter (`GATE_TOOLS python=3.11.15(D:\All projects\WORK-LAB\.project-local\toolchains\wl-py311\Scripts\python.exe)`), and the hook wrapped the call in `if … >/dev/null 2>&1`, so a non-resolving interpreter produced no output and no error; (3) even on the branch where the generator succeeds, line 21 staged `00-governance/generated/CURRENT_STATE.json|.md`, the pre-convergence layout, while the generator writes `.project/governance/generated/CURRENT_STATE.json|.md` -- so the regenerated bytes never entered the commit. Every path then ended in `exit 0`.
errors.root_cause: Three layers of failure, each individually silenced, plus a verification-surface gap that made the staleness invisible until CI. The hook's own contract is 'a projection must not be published stale', and it implemented that contract with `if … ; then … ; fi` and no else: an unresolvable interpreter, a non-existent pathspec and an unparseable script all read as 'nothing to do'. The gap that let it survive two months is that the only command which asks the question -- `generate_current_state.py --check-current` -- runs in `.github/workflows/work-lab-gate.yml` and is not a member of any local gate stage: `governance_test_files()` discovers `tests/workflow-assistance/test_*.py` and `nf*.py`, and no such test wrapped the command. Local green therefore never claimed to cover it, and nothing said so.
errors.fix: `.githooks/** text eol=lf` added to `.gitattributes` (measured after the rule: `git check-attr text eol` -> text: set, eol: lf; the hook rewritten to LF bytes, 0 CRLF, shebang `#!/usr/bin/env bash\n`, `bash -n` clean). The hook now resolves an interpreter in the declared order (project toolchain .exe, project toolchain bin, `python`, `python3`), exits 1 with a named reason when none resolves, exits 1 when the generator exits non-zero, and stages the two paths the generator actually writes -- each failure path prints PRE_COMMIT_FAIL instead of swallowing. Proof it now runs: the commit that carries this fix executed the hook live and its output is in the transcript, `CURRENT_STATE_PASS projection=NO_HEAD_OR_BRANCH_CLAIM modules=2 skills=13 contracts=45 source_digest=55f3237b0127…`, and the tree after the commit held only the files deliberately left unstaged. The surface gap is closed by a gate member: `tests/workflow-assistance/test_current_state_projection_is_fresh.py`, 3 cases (the committed projection is fresh and the passing check names the same digest the record carries; a planted stale digest in a scratch COPY is refused with `source-digest-mismatch`, so the convicting branch is proven not assumed; the generator's declared outputs are the paths the repository uses, and the superseded `00-governance/generated` spelling is asserted absent). Measured: 3 passed.
errors.repeat_prevention: A guard that exists to prevent a state must fail loudly when it cannot run: a hook, script or gate member whose every failure path ends in `exit 0` is not a guard, it is a log of intentions. An author must therefore ask, before trusting any check, 'which command answers this question, and is that command a member of the gate I run locally?' -- if only CI runs it, the local verdict must not be quoted as covering it, and the fix is to wrap it as a test, not to repeat the assumption. Interpreter resolution in a committed script must name the declared toolchain and must never rely on a bare `python` on PATH. Extensionless shell files must be pinned eol=lf, because `text=auto` plus `core.autocrlf=true` silently breaks them at checkout.

errors.root_cause: Three separate causes sharing one mechanism: a reference was written the way it was convenient to say it, not the way the repository resolves it. Shorthands (`skins/b10.css`, `src-tauri/…`) read fine to a human who is standing in that directory and mean nothing to a checker that indexes from the root; the Chinese-named package paths were cited truthfully and were still convicted because the checker's own index was built through a porcelain that mangles non-ASCII names -- the trap this repository has recorded before for `ls-files`/`ls-tree`. The register row is the same mistake in punctuation: a cell containing a `|` is a column break unless it is escaped, and the row that quotes a union type is exactly the row most likely to contain one. And none of this surfaced earlier because `root-governance-suite` is not one of the stages any workflow invokes (measured: no `.github` reference to it) and the pre-push verdicts were taken from `governance` alone -- ERR-261's and ERR-263's coverage gap, in a third location.

errors.repeat_prevention: A path in a document must be written the way the repository resolves it -- root-relative, or declared in-row with the reason -- and never as a shorthand that only reads correctly from inside the directory the author happened to be standing in. Any tool that asks `git` for a file list must use `-z` with `core.quotePath=false` and must not strip its records, because porcelain that quotes non-ASCII names silently deletes every Chinese-named file from the tool's world and the resulting verdict looks like a documentation defect. errors.observed_error: On the Linux runner, twice: run 38130943781 at head 33051db7 and run 38131270591 at 63d9a58c both printed `CI_ROOT_GOVERNANCE_FAIL modules_ran=44 modules_failed=1`, member `test_entry_baseline_projection.py (rc=1)`, message `LookupError: unknown encoding: mbcs`, `Ran 24 tests ... FAILED (errors=1)`. The same command on this Windows box reported the module green, and the 2026-10-11 cloud audit had already recorded it independently as finding W03 (`evidence/work-history-recheck.log`, `evidence/work-mbcs-isolated.log`) with the note that a Linux failure says nothing about whether the Windows parser works.
errors.root_cause: Two places spelled the codec `mbcs`: the instrument decoded ANSI shell-link fields with `raw[...].decode("mbcs")` (four sites) and the test fixture built those bytes with `target.encode("mbcs")` (two sites). `mbcs` is not a codec, it is Windows' name for the system ANSI codepage, and CPython only registers it on Windows -- so `codecs.lookup("mbcs")` raises LookupError on any other host and the gate could not run there at all. Nothing about the .lnk parsing decision was platform-dependent; the harness's vocabulary was. The class of the defect is the same one ERR-266 recorded for the `Path` versus `PureWindowsPath` sites: a host-specific call reached into a pure decision surface, and the machine that could not fail was the one being used as proof.
errors.fix: One decision, one home. `entry_baseline_readback.ansi_codec()` returns `mbcs` on Windows and a declared `cp1252` elsewhere; all four instrument sites and both fixture sites now call it, and `parse_lnk` carries `ansiCodec` plus `ansiCodecBasis` (`assumed cp1252: this host has no system ANSI codepage...`) on the fallback host, so a reading that is not authoritative says so instead of looking like a verified decode. Four new guards in tests/ci/test_entry_baseline_projection.py::AnsiCodecPortabilityTests: an AST check that exactly one `mbcs` literal remains and that it is inside `ansi_codec` (plus a check that the fixture calls MODULE.ansi_codec(), with the forbidden spelling constructed at runtime so the assertion cannot convict its own source line); the ANSI fixture round-trips and names its codec; the non-Windows branch is exercised on EVERY host by swapping the module's `os` binding, so the fallback is proven before a push rather than read out of a CI log; and on Windows the result must NOT carry a basis warning. Falsified with four plants (`.project-local/runs/record-20261011/falsify_ansi_codec_fix.py`): bare mbcs back at a call site, platform decision inverted, codec no longer named in the result, fixture spelling it again -- each convicted its named test and every file restored byte-identical.
errors.repeat_prevention: A codec, path flavour or API that exists on one operating system must be decided in exactly one place inside the module under test, and the test fixture must ask that module rather than repeat the spelling; any fallback must be named in the returned record. Never treat a green run on the author's own platform as evidence that a cross-platform gate works -- exercise the other branch by construction (swap the host binding) before pushing. 必须把平台专有名称收进被测模块的单点决定。
errors.remaining_boundary: The runner is now able to RUN the gate; that is not the same as reading a codepage-936 shortcut correctly on a Linux host, which cp1252 cannot represent (asserted directly: `"应用".encode("cp1252")` raises while cp936 round-trips). The Linux reading is therefore an explicit assumption recorded in `ansiCodecBasis`, and authoritative ANSI readings remain Windows-machine evidence -- which `entry_baseline_readback.py` produces only on this machine, and no CI run substitutes for it.

errors.repeat_prevention: A status word a surface prints about a connection must be derived in exactly one place from (payload, liveness, read failure), never recomputed at the render site, and its gate population must sweep the cross product of transport state and sampling freshness so an expired-but-connected cell cannot hide.

errors.observed_error: W02 / task #32 (P2). Four measured defects on a component with zero test consumers: (1) dragging from the + handle never added an edge — the drop was resolved with `document.elementFromPoint` at a point built from `offsetLeft/offsetTop` while the drag coordinates came from `getBoundingClientRect`, two different origins; (2) connecting started from `onClick` with a MouseEvent cast to a PointerEvent, so `setPointerCapture(undefined)` threw 'No active pointer with the given id'; (3) background panning could never start because the guard was `e.target !== canvasRef.current` and a full-size `.absolute.inset-0` layer always covers the canvas; (4) 适应画布 reset zoom only, never pan.
errors.root_cause: The component mixed two coordinate origins, treated pointer capture as a precondition rather than an optimisation, and hit-tested the DOM instead of the model it already held.
errors.fix: One conversion `toModel()` (rect origin AND pan, then zoom) is now the only place client pixels become model coordinates; the drop target is resolved by a model-space `nodeAt()` hit test; connecting starts on pointerdown where a real pointer id exists; `capturePointer()` swallows a failed capture instead of aborting the gesture; a `connectingRef` is read-and-cleared synchronously so one release bubbling through handle/node/canvas resolves once, not three times; background is 'anything that is not a node'; 适应画布 resets zoom and pan.
errors.repeat_prevention: A canvas gesture must be tested through its pointer lifecycle (down/move/up) and geometry (rect mapping at more than one width), and a hit test must ask the model, never the laid-out DOM: layout hit-testing needs a laid-out document and mixes coordinate origins.
errors.remaining_boundary: jsdom cannot reproduce the browser's NotFoundError on setPointerCapture, so defect (2) is guarded, not re-measured. The rubber-band preview and touch/stylus pointers are untested.

errors.observed_error: 登记索引面在 Windows 上整体误报：WL-REC-0006 与 WL-REC-0039 被判 `archive bytes/hash mismatch`。逐字节核对后登记是对的、树也是对的——工作区那份文本被 git 以 CRLF 检出（58 处 CRLF），磁盘 13,732 B / 6896bb7e…，而 git blob 与登记都是 13,674 B / 8d4a4818…。
errors.root_cause: 校验器哈希工作区副本而不是仓库字节。Windows 检出的文本是 CRLF、blob 是 LF，因此这个结论在任何其它平台上都不成立。若照着它「修」登记，就会把一个 Windows 专属哈希写进权威记录，之后 Linux/macOS 会看到真漂移——把幻影修成真漂移。与 ERR-094 同类。
errors.fix: 受跟踪且无嵌套成员链的归档改为从索引读取（`git show :<path>`），这是仓库自己对任何平台都会给出的答案；LFS 文件在索引里是指针文本，识别后回退工作区文件，否则每个 zip 成员都会被判损坏。登记与树都不需要改动——`OWNER_MATERIAL_CATALOG status=PASS registeredMaterials=104 indexedArchiveMembersIncludingNested=2382 errors=[]`。新守护 `tests/workflow-assistance/test_material_catalog_uses_repository_bytes.py` 三例，含反向对照：真被改过一个字节的归档仍须被判出来。
errors.repeat_prevention: 权威记录的哈希必须以仓库字节为准，不得以检出副本为准；换操作系统重跑校验器必须得到同一个答案。若某条登记只在某个平台成立，它不是登记，是快照。
errors.remaining_boundary: 尚未在 Linux runner 上复跑本守护；该结论目前只在本机（Windows + CRLF 检出）验证成立，反向断言证明了它不会变成橡皮图章。

errors.root_cause: ERR-088's trap is bidirectional and was only closed in one direction on 2026-09-24. Then, DSH_HOME pointed at D: while the C: root was the empty fallback, so the fix was to keep DSH_HOME=D: and archive the C: skeleton. errors.entrypoint: hermes update (git transport selection) -> bootstrap-cache/install-main.ps1 repository stage
errors.command: git -C %LOCALAPPDATA%/hermes/hermes-agent fetch origin --filter=blob:none (through the local proxy) followed by powershell -File install-main.ps1 -IncludeDesktop
errors.observed_error: The requested official Hermes update stalled twice at git fetch: through 127.0.0.1:7890 git moved 3.3 KB/s on a 127 MB partial clone (curl through the same proxy pulled 2.6 MB/s from the same host), and ~/.gitconfig http.lowSpeedTime=999999 made the stall invisible - after 12 s the in-flight tmp_pack_* was 0 bytes and index-pack had 0.00 s CPU growth. While working around it, a session scoped GIT_CONFIG_KEY_1/KEY_2 was exported without a matching GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_2, so every git child died with 'error: missing config value GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_2 / fatal: unable to parse command-line config'. install-main.ps1 then read the checkout as commit-less and MOVED it to hermes-agent.broken-20261013-193500; the installer could not re-clone for the same reason and exited 1, leaving no hermes-agent tree, no node_modules, no packaged desktop app, and Desktop\Hermes.lnk broken.
errors.root_cause: Two independent mistakes, one environmental and one mine. (1) Environmental: for this repo the transport, not the network, is the bottleneck - the vendored partial clone needs one long-lived POST to git-upload-pack, and the proxy throttles that stream while it happily serves short requests at full speed; at the same time the global http.lowSpeedLimit=0 / lowSpeedTime=999999 turned 'slow' into 'hangs forever', so no failure ever surfaced. (2) Mine: git's command-line config protocol requires GIT_CONFIG_KEY_<n> and GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_<n> to be balanced - exporting a key for a slot whose value was optional made git fail closed on EVERY invocation, including the installer's own git, and the installer's correct response to a commit-less checkout (move it aside rather than overwrite it) then removed the live tree. The environment mistake is what made the second mistake destructive.
errors.fix: Recovered in place instead of re-cloning: the moved directory was intact (163 MB pack, complete refs/remotes/origin/*, refs/stash holding the run's autostash 4ad8a8fc), so it was renamed back, the transport was pinned in the REPO config (remote.origin.url = the mirror that measured 654 KB/s, http.proxy = 127.0.0.1:7890, http.lowSpeedTime = 120) rather than in env vars, main was fetched and fast-forwarded to cba45e8a66d32fbeba0735257ac114fda3f5e230 (2026-10-13), the stashed autostash was popped (only a redundant working-tree change remained), and the official installer was re-run with -IncludeDesktop to rebuild the dependency environment and the packaged app. Final readback: 'Hermes Agent v0.21.7+472.gcba45e8 (2026.9.24) - stable', install-stamp dirty=false at commit cba45e8a6, apps/desktop/release/win-unpacked/Hermes.exe 204 MB rebuilt 19:44, node_modules and apps/desktop/node_modules present, and both Desktop and Start-Menu Hermes.lnk resolving end-to-end. remote.origin.url was restored to the canonical https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent.git while the repo-local http.proxy stayed, so the next fetch is both canonical and proxied.
errors.regression_test: scripts/ci/verify_error_ledger.py must read back ERR-277; and a live readback must still show: %LOCALAPPDATA%/hermes/hermes-agent exists as a git checkout with a commit, hermes --version resolving from install-stamp.json, the packaged Hermes.exe present with both shortcuts Test-Path True, and no GIT_CONFIG_KEY_* exported without a matching GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_*
errors.repeat_prevention: Before injecting command-line config into a process tree, the KEY_n/VALUE_n pairs must be balanced and the result must be proven with one cheap readback (git status) BEFORE the long operation starts - an unbalanced pair makes git fail closed on every child, including installers that will then move a checkout aside. For this repo the transport must be pinned in the repository config (http.proxy plus a lowSpeedTime that fails instead of waiting) rather than in session env, because the installer and the updater spawn their own git. Any mirror used as a transport must be reverted to the canonical remote before the run ends, and the run must end with a version plus shortcut readback, never with 'the fetch looked slow'. A moved or renamed checkout must never be treated as lost: .git plus refs/stash is the recovery surface, and the installer's own rename is evidence, not damage.
errors.remaining_boundary: stash@{0} (hermes-update-autostash-20261013-112627) is deliberately KEPT as a safety copy of the pre-recovery working tree even though its content is now redundant; dropping it is the owner's call. The mirror (gh-proxy.com) remains only as a recorded measurement, not as configuration: the repo remote is canonical again and the only persisted deviation is the repo-local http.proxy=http://127.0.0.1:7890 plus http.lowSpeedTime=120. The interactive 'hermes setup' wizard still needs a real console and was not completed here.

errors.entrypoint: config/adapter-registry.json declared client baselines vs the launch-free version readback in scripts/audit/tool_version_metadata_probe.py
errors.command: python scripts/audit/tool_version_metadata_probe.py --registry-lookup (every row launched=false); python -m unittest discover -s tests/workflow-assistance -p test_adapter_version_readback.py
errors.observed_error: Re-reading the managed desktop clients without launching any of them showed the registry describing a machine that no longer exists. DeepSeek Harness was declared 0.2.0-rc.2 while the uninstall entry and the installed executable's own version resource both read 0.2.1-rc.2, which the vendor feed has published since 2026-10-17. Hermes was declared 0.21.5+6948.gedd2476 while its install stamp, rewritten by the updater on 2026-10-13, reads 0.21.7+472.gcba45e8 - the third occurrence of this same drift, after ERR-158 and ERR-159. CC Switch was declared 3.20.0 against an installed 4.0.15. OpenHuman was declared 0.63.12 with no uninstall entry left and no top-level executable, so the probe returned no version at all rather than a wrong one. The guard that was supposed to keep the DeepSeek Harness pin honest demanded only that the observation not be older than the receipt, so the cheapest way to stay green was to keep quoting the stale receipt instead of re-reading the machine.
errors.root_cause: Declared baselines were written as durable facts and never re-read, while the guard was keyed on the age of the observation instead of the shape of its source. A date ceiling rewards an old reading and cannot tell 'this value came from a file the machine still has' apart from 'this value came from a receipt nobody refreshed'. The smaller, second cause: a client can genuinely disappear, and a vocabulary with no state for 'cannot be read' turns an absence into a data error and invites someone to edit the claim until the gate stops firing.
errors.fix: Re-pinned the three live values from the launch-free readback and moved each superseded value into version_historical plus superseded_observation instead of deleting it. CC Switch keeps status legacy_observe because observing what is installed is not a grant of active status. OpenHuman keeps its last verified value but is marked reproducible=false with not_reproducible_since=2026-10-20 and not_reproducible_verdict set to the verdict the probe actually returned, NOT_RESOLVED_AND_NOT_IN_UNINSTALL_REGISTRY. Both DeepSeek Harness pins in AGENTS.md were synced to 0.2.1-rc.2. The date rule was replaced in the readback gate by a source-shape rule - the source must be re-readable without launching anything and the registry must quote verbatim what the probe read - plus four planted falsifiers: a launch-based method, an identifier the probe never read, a removed superseded record, and a receipt that admits it launched something. A stale evidence sentence was also corrected: the 2026-10-13 note claimed the feed's size and sha512 equalled the installed build, which confused an NSIS installer (289,385,456 bytes) with the installed binary (246,343,144 bytes); the new record claims only that the installed executable's own resource and the uninstall key agree on the version the vendor currently publishes.

errors.observed_error: The commit that recorded the ERR-276/ERR-277 binding wrote fixedCommit as the eight-character form 13ed879b, copied from a git log line. The aggregate verifier requires introducedCommit, fixedCommit and verifiedCommit to be a full 40-hexadecimal commit or null, so it answered ERROR_LEDGER_FAIL ERR-276 fixedCommit must be a full 40-hex commit - the row written to record a binding had become the defect, and the push would have been judged red at .github/workflows/work-lab-gate.yml:485.
errors.root_cause: The value was transcribed from human-readable log output instead of being produced by the command that owns commit identity. The single-purpose binding gate that was re-run before committing resolves abbreviations itself, so it stayed green over exactly the field the wire-format gate refuses: re-running one guard for a field is not re-running the guards that read that field.
errors.fix: Extended both rows to the 40-character form generated by git rev-parse and asserted on write, then re-proved the binding with git cat-file -e against that tree and re-published the four index-derived receipts (LEDGER_FIX_COMMIT_BINDING, LEDGER_REGRESSION_COMMAND_TARGETS, PROJECT_LOCAL_CITATION_AUDIT, TOOL_INVENTORY) in the same commit.

errors.entrypoint: scripts/ci/repoint_source_pointers.py default target and tests/workflow-assistance/test_ui_v2_csv_citations_resolve.py vs docs/history/archive/FROZEN-MANIFEST.json and docs/history/archive/MOVED-PATHS-20261019.json
errors.observed_error: Two machine contracts demanded opposite mutations of the same bytes. The pointer repointing tool's default target was docs/history/archive/ui-priority-20261009/UIV2-INTERFACE-BINDING-MATRIX.csv, while that file sits inside an archive pinned twice by hash - the freeze manifest and the move record, both recording 44,208 bytes at a1f5eb3be534. Following the pointer gate's own instruction (re-pin a rotted line number, which commit 3ee7fed5 did) turned both integrity gates red; keeping the integrity gates green left the pointer gate demanding the same edit again the next time any cited source gained a line. The contradiction was invisible in CI because the workflow's fifth step is a command chain that stops at its first failure, and governance failed before root-governance-suite ran.
errors.root_cause: The 2026-10-19 archive normalization moved the matrix into frozen history without re-aiming the tool whose default population was that file, and nothing asserts that a repair tool and a freeze record cannot both own the same path. A pointer claim inside an immutable document is unsatisfiable by construction: the record is a dated measurement, and keeping its line number 'current' would make it say something it never measured.
errors.fix: Chose the freeze. Restored the archived bytes to the value both records pin (proving first that the blobs at c76f5e2e and at 3ee7fed5^ equal it, and keeping the divergent bytes as a rollback copy in .project-local). Added the root guard inside the tool: any target whose path is pinned by the freeze manifest or the move record is refused with REPOINT_FROZEN_REFUSED and exit 1, so a pointer can never again be repaired by breaking a freeze. Replaced the hard-coded default population with the tracked live doc surface enumerated from the git index. The third demand on the same bytes turned out to be tests/workflow-assistance/test_ui_v2_csv_citations_resolve.py, which read the checkout and so required the frozen tables to track HEAD; it now judges each table against the move record's own measuredAtHead, which keeps the claim readable - every pointer in both CSVs lands on its quote as of 983bf571 - without making frozen history expire. 8 tests OK.

errors.observed_error: The documented sidecar launch worked - WORKFLOW_SIDECAR_READY printed, /api/v1/snapshot answered 200 with a revision - and the test still reported an ERROR: PermissionError: [WinError 32] on '%TEMP%\tmpXXXX\runtime\canonical.sqlite' while TemporaryDirectory cleanup tried to delete its own sandbox. Instrumented separately: the child is reaped at t=0 and its sqlite stays locked until roughly 250 ms later, so an immediate delete always loses. Linux unlinks open files, so exact-SHA CI cannot see this class at all.
errors.root_cause: The teardown assumed POSIX unlink semantics, and the assertion that was supposed to prove the documented entry point runs was hostage to a filesystem detail unrelated to the claim. Second, independent mistake: the sandbox was written to the user temp root, which this repo's own data-boundary contract forbids for content the project produces.
errors.fix: Replaced the implicit context-manager cleanup with a bounded release() (12 attempts at 0.25 s) that raises when the tree is still locked instead of ignoring the failure - silent residue would be invisible here and counted days later by the residue floor gate. Moved the sandbox to .project-local/runs/sidecar-launch-tests/. errors.observed_error: On the run of 2026-10-20T19:23Z the root suite reported two failing modules on the runner while the same modules were green in every Windows worktree of this session. test_observer_launcher_chain_is_runnable.py asserted `0 != 60` - sixty lone-LF lines in apps/observer/start-observer.cmd - and test_stale_surface_paths_are_gone.py reported 1 failure plus 2 errors reading docs/history/archive/HANDOFFS-AND-PROMPTS-20261019.zip, whose contents on that host were a 135-byte LFS pointer rather than a ZIP. errors.root_cause: Two claims were written against the author's machine instead of against the artifact. A launcher's line endings were treated as a checkout accident rather than as a shipped property, so nothing declared them; and routing large files to LFS in .gitattributes was decided without checking which job has to read those bytes. Neither could surface earlier because the workflow's structural step is one shell block that stops at its first failing command - root-governance-suite only began executing once governance and the security prose scan upstream were green.
errors.fix: Declared `*.cmd text eol=crlf` and `*.bat text eol=crlf`, measured afterwards as `i/lf w/crlf attr=text eol=crlf` for all three tracked batch launchers, so the CRLF the launcher needs is now a property of every checkout rather than of one host; added `lfs: true` to the checkout of the job that runs the root suite. Replaced the raw ZipFile opens with open_archive(), which names the missing precondition (LFS_NOT_FETCHED, ARCHIVE_MISSING) instead of letting one cause surface as two tracebacks and an unrelated hash mismatch. Extended the guard from the one file to the family and to the host-independence of the claim: the launcher test now also asserts the declared attribute, and a new test enumerates every tracked .cmd/.bat from the git index and requires both CRLF bytes and eol=crlf. Modules went 7 to 8 and 19 to 21 cases.

errors.observed_error: 证据区间读取的身份核对可以在两层同时假通过。后端 read_range 把调用方给的 expected_digest 与同样是调用方给的 whole_digest 相比，从不哈希文件本身；services/orchestration/sidecar.py 的两个值都取自 URL query，所以整条链是「调用方 vs 调用方」。前端 digestVerdictOf 更直接：recorded 与 expected 读的是同一个表达式 result.identity?.wholeDigest，两者按构造相等，于是任何 status=OK 的响应都得到 AGREE，界面文案写「返回字节属于被记录的那份产物」。本机复现：写一个真实 sha256 为 e679f17a328e34b0… 的 fixture，两个参数都传 a×64，status=OK、内容照常返回，界面判 AGREE（回执 .project-local/runs/wl02-repro-20261021/digest-witness-backend-local.json）；审计包在 Linux 容器与候选 head 上量到同一件事。既有测试还把这条同义反复钉成期望（test_a_matching_digest_is_carried_into_the_result 把同一个摘要传两遍；EvidenceView.test.tsx 断言 AGREE），所以绿是在为缺陷作证。
errors.root_cause: 「廉价的区间读不该顺带全量哈希」被实现成「让调用方自己声明实测摘要」。省 IO 的约束是对的，但它把身份的证据来源交给了唯一想要伪造它的那一方；而界面把「两个字段相等」写成了「字节属于被记录的产物」——同一个字段读两遍永远相等，这句话没有任何可证伪的内容。
errors.fix: 读取器在 expected_digest 给出时自己流式实测整文件摘要（新增 _measure_whole_digest，1 MiB 分块），比较基准只有一个来源：实测值；调用方再没有供给「实际摘要」的参数（read_range 的 whole_digest 形参删除，sidecar 不再读该 query）。超过 16 MiB 不静默全量读，改为 IDENTITY_TOO_LARGE_TO_MEASURE 拒绝且不返回字节。identity 拆成 expectedDigest（声明）/ wholeDigest（实测）/ digestSource（measured-by-reader | not-requested | not-measurable）/ verified，来源词表只在一个函数里拼。前端 digestVerdictOf 改判两侧不同字段，AGREE 需要「钉住值存在 + 读取器确实实测 + 两者相等」；界面把「记录摘要」一格拆成「钉住摘要（调用方声明）」与「实测摘要（读取器计算）」两格。删除已不可达的 DIGEST_UNAVAILABLE，新增 tests/ci/test_evidence_reason_codes_are_one_list.py（6 例）钉住两侧码表不漂移——它正是会发现「客户端还注册着一个后端已经发不出的码」的那种门。
errors.regressionTestVerifiabilityReason: 25→30 例，判决数是实测的：把读取器的实测基准换回调用方 supplied 的摘要后 7 例判红（含审计包原探针、改文件后旧身份失效、路由真 URL 复现、无钉住时报 not-requested、超限自报不可核验、用 TypeError 断言whole_digest 参数不能回来；真 HTTP 路由另有一例复现原 URL。前端 29 例含「只有一个摘要的响应体不得判 AGREE」与「实测≠钉住即 MISMATCH」；把旧的同一字段自比植入回去，2 例立刻判红后逐字节恢复（sha256 前缀 0a029b58）

errors.observed_error: 把手区块「首屏可见中位 3,260 ms」是仪器自己的 sleep，不是页面延迟，而它已经被写进当前权威叙事。旧实现从求值那一刻起做 20 ms 轮询，但共享的 serve_and_eval 把 URL 写在 Chrome 命令行上（导航从那里开始），随后固定 sleep(2.0) 等 CDP 端口、再 sleep(1.0) 才求值，所以最早一次观察已在导航之后约 3.2 秒。样本自己就供出了矛盾：5 次加载 rowsMs 与 capacityMs **每次都相等**（循环第一次迭代就 break），同样本 domContentLoadedMs 只有约 140 ms，极差 14 ms 是一个 sleep() 的形状。docs/current/authority-convergence-20261019/AUTHORITY-CONVERGENCE-20261019.md 据此写下「那 3.26 秒几乎全在页面一侧」，把仪器缺陷转述成了产品结论。
errors.root_cause: 时间戳取自「仪器什么时候看」而不是「页面什么时候出现」。轮询没有回答「我第一次看的时候事情是否已经发生」这个问题，而它报出的数字与答案无关；文档又把这个数抄成产品事实，门里没有任何一条断言检查观察必须早于事件。
errors.fix: 仪器改为在导航**之前**用 Page.addScriptToEvaluateOnNewDocument 把记录器装进页面，所有边界用页面自己的单调时钟 performance.now() 打点：MutationObserver 抓行列表首个子节点，Response.prototype.json 与 JSON.parse 两侧都包（SSE 帧也能喂渲染，只包 fetch 会把因果配错、量出负的提交段——本机真的出现过 -3 ms），可见性按行元素**自身** rect 判（第一版观察 closest('section') 得到 ratio=1 与 belowFold=true 并存）。回执绑定 bundle_provenance.describe 的包体哈希（兄弟门一直这么做，这支没有）。实测（1280×820→CSS 视口 1262×668，真 sidecar，4 次全新加载，包体 assets/index-C1tK2WFi.js sha256 前缀 8e793275）：A 快照解析 150/161 ms、B React 提交 59.5/66 ms、C 到首可见 54.5/58 ms、合计 207.5/222 ms，同次读数 readbackAtMs=3535——仪器比事件晚 3.3 秒看。更正叙事原文并把「首屏不可见」改归为几何问题（提交时行列表 rect.top=884 而视口高 668，列表高 23,056 px 未虚拟化，滚后仅 2.2% 可见）。
errors.regressionTestVerifiabilityReason: 15 例，判决函数保持纯函数以便植入：记录器没装上→只报「没量到」不给数字；rowsAt 不早于读数→点名「recorded at read time」；段缺失或为负→按名判红并指明是仪器坏；屏下却报 0 ms 滚动→矛盾；回执无包体哈希→不得被引用；必测段名从页面表达式里解析，改名即判红；再断言 addScriptToEvaluateOnNewDocument 早于 Page.navigate、且旧的 20 ms 轮询表达式不许回来
errors.repeat_prevention: 任何「延迟」类仪器必须自己回答「我看到的时候，事情是否已经发生」：时间戳要由被测方在生产时刻记录，读数只是取回；样本里两个本应不同的标记完全相等、或极差小得像常量，先怀疑仪器而不是怀疑产品。
errors.remaining_boundary: 本机的 headless Chrome 与 owner 桌面不是同一台机器，绝对毫秒数不可跨宿主引用，可引用的只有形状与量级；sidecar 不发 content-length 导致 responseStart=0，「纯服务端耗时」仍不可测，仪器按 unmeasurable 上报；把手块首屏不可见是否要改成窗口化/默认可达，是产品判断，本轮只把事实与断言落下来，没有改界面布局。

errors.repeat_prevention: 任何驱动真浏览器的采集器必须等「被测对象出现」而不是等「过了几秒」：固定 sleep 的预算属于作者的宿主，不属于 runner；等待本身还必须把时长与是否等到写进收据，否则冷启动竞态与真实渲染缺陷在外部不可区分，下一次只会重跑一次运气而不是一条判决。
errors.remaining_boundary: 本轮的判决权在 runner：修复后的 exact-SHA 运行是否让 full 视图转绿，只能在下一个 head 的 CI 上读到；本机只能证明同一包体三视图全绿且 readyWait={ms:0, mounted:true}（本机本来就快）。24 s 是新写的预算，若 runner 更慢仍会超时，但那时收据会写明 mounted=false 与等待毫秒数，而不是一串读不出原因的 MISSING。同一作业里 desktop capability probe 的 session=FAIL （SESSIONNAME=null）与 U19 的 SKIPPED_HEADLESS 是既有环境性质，本行不改变它们。

errors.observed_error: main 的第二个 head 9513c216（run 39663107318）再次判红，还是这一步：同一作业里几何门 19:52:33 GEOMETRY_GATE_PASS，扫掠 19:52:49 报 `LEGIBILITY_GATE_NOT_RUN views/dark at 1280px TimeoutError('timed out')`，相差 16 秒；上一个 head ed7b8fa6 是 light 主题同形状。两次都发生在 main 上、都不在 PR head 上、开发机一次都没复现。而拒收点写成只 print 异常的 repr：连着两次 main 红无法归因——判决存在，证据不存在，这正是 ERR-281 记过的「报告打不出自己的明细」。
errors.root_cause: 三个叠在一起。(a) 归因被抢跑：ERR-287 只凭「本机 35 秒 / 默认 60 秒」就把红解释成应答预算不足，没有先拿到 raise 的位置；预算参数化是对的，把它当成原因就是无证据推断。(b) 拒收路径丢掉栈，一个自己不打明细的门红了也只能靠重跑碰运气。(c) 同一份字节在 runner 上时好时坏，且失败发生在另一个浏览器会话刚关闭的几秒内——这是启动竞态的形状，不是被测页面的形状。
errors.fix: 两处拒收点补 traceback.print_exc()，下一次红能指出 raise 在哪一层；整轨会话包一层有界重试 run_views_session(attempts=2)：每次失败打印 attempt=i/n 与栈，成功那次把 collected.sweepAttempts 写进取收据，两次都失败仍然抛出、步骤仍然 exit 3 报 NOT_RUN。重试不是重掷硬币：它是有记录的事实，也是区分「页面坏了」（两次都失败）与「启动竞态」（第二次就成）最便宜的判据。同时把 ERR-287 的 remaining_boundary 改成记录它自己被证伪，而不是悄悄改写那条断言。
errors.regressionTestVerifiabilityReason: 14→18 例：重试计数进回执、持续失败仍抛出最后一个错、attempts=1 不得变成静默、两处拒收点必须 print traceback（计数断言）。本机复跑两主题 LEGIBILITY_GATE_PASS 且 sweepAttempts=1，证明快路径没有被重试掩盖。
errors.repeat_prevention: 凡自己会判红的门必须先交出 raise 的位置再谈原因：只有 repr(exception) 的拒收点等于让下一次红不可归因。修一次没修对时，必须回答「我的证据支持到哪一步」，不能把一次有用的参数化写成原因。接进 CI 的浏览器步骤必须能区分启动竞态与被测缺陷，而且区分方式要留在收据里（第几次尝试），不允许静默重跑。
errors.remaining_boundary: 【本行“启动竞态”的假设同样被推翻，见 ERR-289】traceback 显示 raise 在 _recv_text → one_frame → recv，且 attempt=1/2 与 attempt=2/2 抛出完全相同的 TimeoutError：那是确定性阈值，不是竞态。补 traceback 这条改动是本次能归因的唯一原因，保留；有界重试没有救下任何东西，只是被证明无害。为什么 PR head 绿、main 红也由同一机制解释：这条路径的快慢决定静默期是否越过 10 秒，与分支无关。 【边界已闭合，2026-10-22】重试没有被用到：main 那次运行的扫掠一次走完，日志里没有 LEGIBILITY_SWEEP_ATTEMPT 行；本行与 ERR-287 的 verifiedCommit 都钉到 97c9758c。「PR head 绿、main 红」的疑问由 ERR-289 的机制解释，不需要再留问。

errors.observed_error: 补上 traceback 之后红变得可读，也就当场推翻了 ERR-287 与 ERR-288 两次的解释。ff3348bf （run 39668208804）的栈：run_views_session → serve_and_eval 的 raw = cdp.evaluate(expr) → send → _recv_text → one_frame → ws.recv → TimeoutError: timed out；attempt=1/2 与 attempt=2/2 抛出完全相同的异常。机制是：ChromeCDP 建连时 create_connection(..., timeout=10) 把 socket 每次读的超时写死成 10 秒，而 self.timeout 只用于跳帧循环的 deadline。整轨扫掠的表达式在 runner 上存在 >10 秒不吐 websocket 帧的静默期，于是任何一次 recv 到点就抛，外层提到 300 秒毫无作用。开发机没有这个静默期，所以本机永远复现不了——这也解释了 PR head 与 main 的差别只在于当时宿主快慢，与分支无关。
errors.root_cause: 同一个语义被两处各自实现：一处声明“能等多久”，另一处硬编码“每次读只等 10 秒”，而且较紧的那一层不可见。ERR-287 修的是可见的那层，所以修不动；两次归因（预算不足、启动竞态）都是在没有 raise 位置的情况下猜的，第二次猜得更具体，因此错得更明显。
errors.fix: 应答预算只留一个数：socket 的每次读超时就是声明的 timeout（create_connection(timeout=timeout)），删除硬编码的 10 秒。守卫 tests/ci/test_cdp_harness_waits_for_mount.py 18→21 例：声明 300 时 socket 必须是 300、cdp.timeout 与 socket 超时必须相等、默认 60 仍是 60、ChromeCDP 构造里不得再出现 timeout=10。把 timeout=timeout 换回 timeout=10 后 3 例判红，随后逐字节恢复。ERR-287 与 ERR-288 的被推翻之处按各自 remaining_boundary 就地标注，不改写原始断言。
errors.regressionTestVerifiabilityReason: 用 unittest.mock 打桩 socket.create_connection 记录真实传入的 timeout，并把 ChromeCDP 的 handshake 需求喂满，因此断言的是构造期的实际值而不是源码字符串；反向植入 timeout=10 立刻判红 3 例
errors.repeat_prevention: 同一个“能等多久”的语义只能有一个来源：任何声明的预算都必须一直走到真正阻塞的那一层（socket 的读、循环的 deadline、进程的 wait），中间不允许出现第二处硬编码常量。没有 raise 位置之前不得写归因：本仓在同一条红上连续错了两次。
errors.remaining_boundary: 本地复跑几何门与整轨扫掠均 PASS，但 runner 上是否彻底不再红只能由下一个 exact-SHA 判决说明，因此本行与 ERR-287、ERR-288 的 verifiedCommit 都留空。另外这层改动让一次真正卡死的表达式现在可以等满 300 秒才失败——CI 时间代价由 40 分钟作业上限兜住，尚未按 runner 观测重算扫掠的墙钟耗时。 【边界已闭合，2026-10-22】runner 上不再红：`bf3e189c` 的 exact-SHA 运行 12 枚 check-run 全 success，合并后 main 自己的运行（97c9758c，run 39678850519）7 枚作业全 success，observer 里几何门 21:43:04Z 判绿、扫掠 21:44:36Z 判绿，三行的 verifiedCommit 已钉。墙钟代价按 runner 重算：扫掠那一步两主题约 92 秒（PR 上那次约 84 秒），而一次真正卡死的表达式现在要等满声明的 300 秒才失败——这是新的上界，不是已经付出的代价。

errors.observed_error: 给问题中心喂真库样本时，第一次写 collector_health 就死在 `sqlite3.OperationalError: incomplete input`。我传的是 `refused_rows=5`，而这个写者的键表是 camelCase（`refusedRows`）；未映射的键被逐条 `continue` 跳过，于是拼出的语句是 `INSERT INTO collector_health (name, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?) ON CONFLICT(name) DO UPDATE SET`——SET 后面什么都没有。只带 `name` 的调用同样落到这里。
errors.root_cause: 两套词汇（写入 camelCase / 读回 snake_case）之间没有守卫：写者对未知键的策略是静默忽略，而它唯一的"全部被忽略"检测藏在 `if assignments else ""` 里，那条分支的目的只是避免多余的逗号，不是拒绝一次什么都没写的写。静默跳过键名拼错，比抛错更坏：调用方拿到"成功"，健康表里那列却还是旧值。
errors.fix: 写者改为先校验词汇表：任何非 `name` 且不在 `_COLLECTOR_HEALTH_COLUMNS` 里的键抛出 ValueError 并在消息里列出未知名与可写名（让拼错自己现形）；只剩 `name` 的空写同样拒绝；`DO UPDATE SET` 的可选逗号分支删掉，因为它现在不可能为空。既有调用方（durable_worker 与全部测试）本来就用已映射键，实测不受影响。
errors.regressionTestVerifiabilityReason: 新例把两种失败形态都喂进去：未映射键与只有 name 的记录各断言一次 ValueError，并检查错误消息里同时出现拼错的名与正确的名，最后断言 collector_health 仍为 0 行——证明拒绝发生在写之前，不是写完再回滚。
errors.repeat_prevention: 凡"写入词汇表"与"读回列名"不同形的 API，写路径必须对未知键名 fail fast 并把可写名印在错误里；每处由键集合拼出的 SQL 都必须拒绝空集合，禁止把"没匹配到列"实现成静默跳过。
errors.remaining_boundary: 同类形状未逐一排查：`upsert_execution_instance` / `upsert_task` / `append_execution_evidence` 用的是同一类"只写调用方点名的字段"策略，本轮只实测了 collector_health 这一条。本行 fixedCommit 指向产品修复提交，verifiedCommit 等 exact-SHA CI 判绿后再钉。2026-10-22：这句承诺已在 7ee6ab6bc52537ecb8e1924eb244afc23b97e63d 兑现——该提交自身的 work-lab-gate 里 `workflow-assistance` 作业判 success，而该作业的必测集合包含本行的 regression_test；`LEDGER_FIX_COMMIT_BINDING` 在同一次提交里重发并读回本行 verified=7ee6ab6bc52537ecb8e1924eb244afc23b97e63d。仍未闭合的是上面那句：同形的另外三个写者本轮没有逐一实测。
